**Implementation note:** Diagnostics only; not wired as a gate.

## Description

Estimates persistence versus anti-persistence in a rolling time series and permits trend or mean-reversion signals only in the appropriate estimated regime.

## Where it may fit

Useful as a model-selection hypothesis when behavior shifts between persistent and mean-reverting phases.

## Vehicles

Equity ETFs, futures, FX and crypto; often a signal filter, not a standalone strategy.

## Required data

Rolling returns or log prices, sufficiently long lookback, volatility controls and regime-state history.

## Caveats

Hurst estimates are noisy and method-sensitive; choose thresholds out-of-sample and do not assume the estimator identifies a stable regime.
